args.body:
Dear Harborview Properties LLC,

On behalf of Brightline Studio Inc., I am writing to formally notify you of our intention to renew the lease for the premises at 220 Hudson Street, New York, NY 10013. This notice is provided in accordance with the lease agreement and is submitted before the deadline of December 31, 2026. The current rent is $9,017.65.

Sincerely,
[YOUR NAME]
